title: Vivid Diamonds
description: Retextures vanilla diamonds and tools to a more palatable shade of blue.
body:
This is a simple QOL change that retextures diamonds to a more vivid and palatable shade of blue, rather than their original greenish-cyan colour. Add this to your game for a more soothing experience.

(The textures in this pack are a modification of Jappa's vanilla textures).
